body:
New repo, upstream GitHub pre-created by founder. Real, direct answer to 'design it to run with the gc turned off': Go's debug.SetGCPercent(-1)/GOGC=off are real stdlib mechanisms but disabling GC is a whole-process host decision, not an emitter feature -- what v0 scope guarantees: generated functions never allocate on the Go heap by construction (same narrow scalar-param, one-expression-body shape as emit_ts.c/emit_java.c), making GC-off safe for a real host (GoblinFoxDragon's Go backend named candidate). Two Go-specific differences flagged ahead of implementation: if -> IIFE (no ternary in Go), conditional math/rand import. Registered in monorepo CLAUDE.md + golden-docs-index (BURROW-NORTH). Commits 244aab3/3af5c69. Scoping only, no emit_go code yet -- next real step is the emitter itself, same template as emit_ts.c/emit_java.c.

⚓ ☃
title: BURROW NORTHSTAR scoping pass -- PARENA's 4th compilation target (Go, GC-off design)
